name: What are the next steps after an emergency storm damage assessment?

mainEntity.name: What are the next steps after an emergency storm damage assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: After an emergency storm damage assessment, Discounted Roofing Co. will provide you with a detailed report of the findings and recommended repairs. We can then assist you in navigating the insurance claims process, if applicable, and provide a comprehensive estimate for the necessary work. Our team will explain all options and help you decide on the most effective course of action to restore your roof's integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Following the assessment, you'll receive a detailed report and repair recommendations. We can then assist with insurance claims and provide an estimate to help you decide on next steps.
